Source: https://github.com/crosire/reshade
Commit: eeb2c76aea8e00200d88b479c9036c5ea4d06d5e
Only the compiler dependency files required by MacShade are included.

Local Apple portability patches (guarded by __APPLE__):

- source/effect_symbol_table.cpp includes <alloca.h> on Apple platforms,
  where alloca is declared, instead of the upstream <malloc.h> include.
  Other platforms retain the original include.

- source/effect_lexer.cpp includes <xlocale.h> and <cstdlib> on Apple
  platforms. In the standard floating-literal parsing path, it copies the
  token's character range into a terminated std::string and calls strtof_l
  with a process-lifetime C numeric locale created by newlocale. This keeps
  decimal parsing independent of the user's numeric locale while avoiding
  Apple's floating-point std::from_chars availability requirement of
  macOS 26, so MacShade can retain its macOS 12 deployment target.
  The existing alternate parser branch and non-Apple std::from_chars path
  remain in place.

These are local modifications to the pinned compiler source, not changes
claimed to be present in the upstream commit. Original source copyright
notices and the BSD-3-Clause license are retained.
